shuffled_real_volume.description: Oracle negative control: pair each validation target with another complete real validation volume window under one fixed derangement. Uses held-out future volumes and is not a simulator.

identity.description: Oracle identity check: each real validation volume window is compared with itself; this is not a forecast or generator.

real_volume_changes.scope: Exact share-count changes. Within-window measures use future updates 1..32 (31 transitions); anchor-inclusive measures add update 0..1 (32 transitions). Fractions average the 20 ask/bid volume cells equally.

conclusion: At the fixed final step 4000, matched starting volumes change depth SSIM from 0.1788 to 0.2829 (gain +0.1041). The joint pilot screen is not met: abs_return_acf_mae increase at most 5%; Fixed-context noise SD ratios at least 0.1 in every case. Spread KL is 0.1413 → 0.0854; return KL 0.9994 → 0.5113; ACF error 0.1471 → 0.3521; invalid snapshots 0.00% → 0.00%. Known-starting-volume persistence has depth SSIM 0.4431; it is an untrained depth-only diagnostic, and its information budget differs from earlier price-only studies. This is one training seed. An SSIM gain or a passed relative screen alone does not establish simulator adequacy; absolute targets, fixed-case dynamics and noise response remain relevant.
next_step: Stop at the declared pair budget, retain the negative/trade-off evidence and inspect the failed criteria before proposing another controlled change. No further training is scheduled or initiated by this report.
